title: The Zak phase in topologically insulating chains: invariants and limitations
summary: In this work we investigate the topological content of the Zak phase in one-dimensional translation-invariant topological insulators endowed with time-reversal, particle-hole and/or chiral symmetries, extending results from \cite{Monaco_2023}. We analyze the extent to which the Zak phase captures the topology of all Altland--Zirnbauer--Cartan (AZC) symmetry classes in $1$D. Building on the framework of fibered Hamiltonians and spectral projections, we construct symmetric Bloch bases adapted to the discrete symmetries of the system and define a $\mathbb{Z}_2$-valued topological invariant…
